name: wordpress-stack
description: WordPress with MySQL - full LAMP stack with persistent storage

scripts.setup:
# Start MySQL
service mysql start
sleep 3

# Create WordPress database and user
mysql -e "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS wordpress;"
mysql -e "CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS 'wpuser'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY 'wppassword';"
mysql -e "GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON wordpress.* TO 'wpuser'@'localhost';"
mysql -e "FLUSH PRIVILEGES;"

# Download WordPress if not already present
if [ ! -f /var/www/html/wp-config.php ]; then
  cd /tmp
  wget https://wordpress.org/latest.tar.gz
  tar xzf latest.tar.gz
  cp -r wordpress/* /var/www/html/
  rm -rf wordpress latest.tar.gz
  
  # Create wp-config.php
  cd /var/www/html
  cp wp-config-sample.php wp-config.php
  sed -i "s/database_name_here/wordpress/" wp-config.php
  sed -i "s/username_here/wpuser/" wp-config.php
  sed -i "s/password_here/wppassword/" wp-config.php
  
  # Set ownership
  chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www/html
fi

# Configure Apache
a2enmod rewrite
service apache2 restart

echo "WordPress stack ready!"
echo "MySQL Database: wordpress"
echo "MySQL User: wpuser / Password: wppassword"
echo "Access WordPress at: http://localhost:8080"
